36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
271367: Rakurou, better known by his nickname "Sunraku," is an enthusiast of Kusoge (shit games); games that are well-known for buggy states, unfair mechanics and awful AI. He is well known by his friends as a Kusoge fanatic and lunatic.
281519: A highly skilled player in Shangri-La Frontier who holds the special title of "Attack Holder"—an honor bestowed upon the player who has unleashed the highest burst damage in the game.
281520: The second-in-command of the Ashura-Kai, an extremist PK clan whose primary activity is player-killing. Excelling in strategy and information warfare, she bears the moniker "Giant Killer"—a title earned by her ability to defeat even players of a significantly higher level.
281521: A gaming companion Sanraku met through a "kusoge" (crappy game), and one of Japan's top-tier professional fighting game players, currently affiliated with a pro gaming team under the handle Kei.
281522: Vorpal Bunny and the NPC guide for the unique quest that Sunraku encounters, titled “Invitation from Rabituza”. She is the daugher of Vysache, the leader of the Vorpal Bunnies, and has 5 siblings including Peatz, Bilac, and Elke.
281523: Emul's father and the chieftain of the race known as the Vorpal Bunnies. His physique—vastly larger and more formidable than that of any other Vorpal Bunny—possesses a sheer intensity that overawes all who behold it.
312744: Kuon Amane, also known as Orcelott is the Younger brother of Arthur Pencilgon.
312745: The leader of Schwarzer Wolf—a top-tier clan dedicated to the extermination of Lycagon the Nightslayer. Saiga-0, who holds the title of Attack Holder, is also a member, and the leader commands a formidable roster of highly skilled individuals.
312746: The leader of SF-Zoo, a clan whose purpose is to observe and photograph monsters. A sorcerer who mastered abnormal status (debuffs) just to photograph monsters. She shows an abnormal obsession with monsters.
313385: Emul's younger brother. A merchant rabbit who speaks with a Kansai dialect, he procures goods to sell in the Rabbit Kingdom, Rabituza. Capable of taking on a human form, he also conducts business in other towns outside of Rabituza.
313386: Emul's older sister and the eldest daughter of Vysache. She inherited the craft of blacksmithing from her father, and holds his skills in high esteem. She speaks a sort of "pseudo-Hiroshima dialect" that is subtly laced with the common tongue.
313387: One of the Seven Colossi—Unique Monsters that inhabit the world of Shangri-La Frontier. He is an peerless hero who ceaselessly stands guard over the grave of his beloved, who passed away in the distant past.
313388: One of the Seven Colossi—Unique Monsters that inhabit the world of Shangri-La Frontier. Elusive and unpredictable, it materializes suddenly from the shadows. Its specific spawn conditions remain unknown.
313426: A pioneer (player) who has been acknowledged—and marked with a curse—by Siegwurm the Sky Ruler, one of the Seven Colossi. Possessing a cheerful, uninhibited, and athletic temperament, they wear a fox mask and cut the figure of a ninja.
313428: The son of Vysache and the older brother of Emul. He wears a suit of armor and speaks in a samurai-like manner. He brings Akane Akitsu—a Pioneer recognized by Siegwurm the Sky Ruler, one of the Seven Colossi—to the Rabbits' base with the intention of introducing her to Vysache.
313430: Director of Public Relations at Utopia Corp. He is the only person capable of mediating between Tsukuyo Tsukuri and Ritsu Amachi, who are constantly at odds. Consequently, he is never without his stomach medication.
313431: The founder of Utopia Inc. and a genius creator, she serves as the World Creative Administrator responsible for creating Shangri-La Frontier.
313434: Emul's older sister. She sells skills at the Skill Gardener—a specialized pruning facility located within the Rabbit Palace. She wears a perpetual smile and is characterized by her gentle, drawn-out manner of speaking. She is also adept at combining skills.
313435: The leader of the analysis clan Library. With the ultimate goal of unraveling the mysteries of Shangri-La Frontier, they make contact with Sunraku after he defeats a Unique Monster. Despite their adorable, magical-girl-like appearance, their voice is surprisingly deep and dandy.
313437: A Unique NPC who holds the secret to Wezaemon the Tombguard—one of the game's formidable Unique Monsters. She can be encountered in the Hidden Garden, a secret area where spider lilies bloom in profusion.
313438: Executive Producer of Shangri-La Frontier. Her job is to adjust the impossibly difficult difficulty level set by Sakai Tsukuyogi and make the game playable. She sometimes gets into childish, physical fights with Tsukuyo Tsukuri.
313439: The Vice-Captain of the Booted Musketeers of Cazzeria—the land of the Cat Fairies (Cait Sith). He harbors romantic feelings for Beelach and frequently makes ardent advances toward her, only to face repeated, crushing rejections.
313440: Rust's partner—a person possessed of a cool and level head. They return to Shangri-La Frontier alongside Rust. Even within the world of Shangri-La Frontier, they serve as the steady anchor who keeps Rust's headstrong, bull-in-a-china-shop tendencies in check.
313441: A formidable player who long held the number one spot in Nephilim Hollow. Prompted by Sunraku inadvertently letting slip that Shangri-La Frontier also features robots, they make their return to the world of Shangri-La Frontier.
313853: An NPC through whom players can accept a Unique Scenario linked to Ctarnidd of the Abyss—one of the Seven Colossi, a group of Unique Monsters. Although he looks like a mere brat, he serves as the captain of the Scarlet Whale, the vessel sailed by the Redwhale Pirates.
314244: An NPC. To repay the debt owed to Sunraku for saving their life, they accompany him on his exploration of the Abyssal Capital, Ruluiath. His grandfather was the only member of the Fish-folk race to ever pierce Ctarnidd's Left Eye and escape Ruluiath alive.
314248: The sole female member of StarRain—one of the most formidable fighting game teams in the United States.
314249: A professional fighting game player who belongs to the same team as Kei Uomi, the Nitro Squad. Her player name is “Nu2meg.” She is a starting member of one of Japan's top teams, and her gaming skills are among the best in the country.
318275: Chimera with a shark's head, the body of a mole with long arms, and a catfish's whiskers. It is the area boss monster of Diremarsh Waste, near Secondil. Players must defeat it in order to reach Thirdrema.
318276: Massive poisonous snake that is the area boss monster of The Rampant Forest near Firstia. Players must defeat it in order to reach Seondil.
319446: A humanoid monster reminiscent of a sorcerer, its body is composed of withered bark and its hair of branches.
